svg.title: L App processes and App-owned Service libraries light
svg.desc: The native orchestrator runs source actions in order. Run launches App binaries as separate OS processes; Await joins. An App may own Service libraries, which are separate Cargo library build artifacts. The ownership connector does not imply a runtime call or automatic library linkage. Standalone Service declarations remain structural values and create no artifact or process.

g.data-label: Apps execute in separate OS processes; App-owned Services provide library artifacts.
g.text: Apps execute in separate OS processes; App-owned Services provide library artifacts.
